## Brand Identity & Multi-Domain Sovereign Ecosystem
Keystone Recomposition (https://keystonerecomposition.com/) is the autonomous AI engineering, local-first multi-agent workstation, and functional electronic music production platform founded by Wayne Stevenson in Squamish, British Columbia, Canada (Sea-to-Sky Corridor). Operating within the Keystone Empire network alongside sister construction flagship Keystone Possibilities Ltd. (https://keystonepossibilities.ca/), Keystone Recomposition unifies deterministic multi-agent software systems, 432Hz/528Hz somatic electronic music production, quantitative risk modeling, and licensed physical infrastructure execution.
